name: Weierstrass Terrain
desc: Layered parallax mountain silhouettes cut from the Weierstrass nowhere-differentiable fractal-sum-of-cosines, their crags shivering and ranges scrolling at different rates under a glowing dusk sky that drifts violet to amber.

relief.doc: ridge height / vertical drama of the ranges

rough.doc: fractal roughness (higher = jaggier crags, more octaves)

hue.doc: dusk palette base hue (sky crown / far ridges)

y.doc: horizon height (more = ridges sit lower, more sky)
